# Gilbert Blythe & Shirley

- [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) — Rival of — [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) — intense academic rivalry for top marks in school · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>
- [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) — Friend of — [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) — friendship · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXVI Around the Bend P46](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0046), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P40](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0040)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) meets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to say a dramatic final goodbye due to her mother's orders, though they remain secret friends. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to return to school, where she receives a warm welcome from her classmates and enters an intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has won the medal and she has won the Avery scholarship. After Commencement, she returns home to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), reuniting with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), though she learns about Matthew's failing heart, Marilla's eye trouble, and rumors of bank instability. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a restful day visiting her favorite outdoor spots and walking with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), who tenderly expresses how proud he is of his girl.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream

> Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) Lynde's death, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) invites the widowed Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), enabling [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to leave her teaching post and attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). News of Anne's resignation causes sorrow among her pupils and friends, though [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is delighted. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss their upcoming separations, local gossip, and hopes for the future.
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes her teaching term, leaving local mothers to gossip about her future and [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). She later visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and then Paul's home, where she meets Paul's father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), who asks her to pass a message to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) joyfully acts as a matchmaker, delivering Stephen's request and helping Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for his arrival.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

> [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) is buzzing with preparations for Miss Lavendar's upcoming wedding, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and Charlotta the Fourth helping out. [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) share their perspectives on the romance, highlighting the difference between seeing life through poetry versus prose. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later discovers that [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) are secretly engaged, leading to a heartfelt conversation between the two friends about love and their futures.
>
> — v2 · XXIX Poetry and Prose

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) help Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and Charlotta the Fourth prepare [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) for the upcoming wedding. The next day, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) are married in the garden surrounded by friends, after which the wedding party sees them off at [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) station. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to clean up the stone house with [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) and later walks home with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), experiencing a quiet moment of romantic awakening.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys her summer in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) despite feeling a lonely ache from Gilbert's absence and lack of letters. She spends time with [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md), and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) while [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) confronts the reality of growing up and leaving childhood imaginings behind. Later, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her relationship with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), gently warning her that they were meant for each other.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIII Paul Cannot Find the Rock People

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to take a walk in the park on a windy autumn day, reflecting on her changing relationship with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). When her umbrella breaks in a sudden rainstorm, she is rescued by Royal Gardner, a handsome student who shares shelter and walks her back to Patty's Place. That evening, [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) sends [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a dozen roses, sparking excitement and romantic speculation among her friends.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXV Enter Prince Charming

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) from [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and is devastated to learn that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is critically ill with typhoid fever. During a painful night of worry, she realizes her true, deep love for him. At dawn, [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) passes by with the news that Gilbert's fever has broken and he will recover, filling [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with immense joy and relief.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XL A Book of Revelation
